item_taken.first_six_words: Zwicky's box: the universe is the
item_taken.why: The case names its carrier as the product (easting by northing, cut at ten kilometres), its cells are coordinates a record is placed at (two letters and two digits, a species in a square), its fraction is cells filled over cells, and a member reads as coordinates plus a case; not Round wall (0), whose cardinal has no cells and no named members, where here every square is named and can receive a card; not Compiler's catalogue (1), whose members are derivations of a grammar; not Filing classes (3), whose partition was made for filing and keeps a residual bin, where the grid has no other bin and the sea square and the estate square stay in the denominator rather than being filed as misfits; not Induced cells (15), whose axes are read off the pile, where the grid was fixed by the scheme before any card was returned.

reasoning: The rule has two clauses joined by what the case is. First clause: if the case is the product or grid taken as the universe the enumerator counts against, it is here. The case's own first sentence says exactly that: the 10-kilometre squares were the universe to count against, fixed before any card came back; its four parts (carrier, what it makes countable, what it drops, the tell) are all about the cell count the fraction is taken against and how that count moves with the cut. So the first clause fires. Second clause: if the case is what one of the product's empty cells yields, a predicted member or an errand, it is form-yields'. The case does hold errands as concrete facts (a square with no card in the 1950s sent a recorder there; at the tetrad cut twenty-four blanks each become a place to send someone; the number of errands moves with the cut), but they appear as evidence for the tell that the denominator was manufactured, not as the case's subject. The case is not an errand or a predicted member; it is a universe with a fraction in which blanks yield errands. On the rule as written the case stays here. What would send it across: the same facts restated with the errand as the subject, the recorder sent to the blank square or the twenty-four tetrad errands, and the grid as the form that produced them. The map's own boundary says the same: the empty cell's yield is form-yields', this map holds only the universe the cell count manufactures.
